episodes.short: Scale the product without losing delivery state

episodes.label: Build 4 · From lists to intelligence
episodes.short: Eight parallel epics, an evidence-driven redesign, and a corrected agent boundary

commands.decision: Confirm source identity and permissions before mutation
Read the current immutable run state
Recover the gate, evidence and next action
Freeze durable state before writer replacement
Resolve an uncertain result without a blind retry
Reject stale candidate or invalid recovery evidence
Review the exact GitHub projection before writing
Apply once and reconcile duplicate intent

decisions.label: Browser contradicts green tests
decisions.observation: The exact Crates journey returned zero results in a long-running process.
decisions.rule: Review evidence must agree with the user-visible acceptance case.
decisions.result: Returned Review to Implementation; withdrew the claim; restarted and retested.

decisions.label: A consumed plan is reused
decisions.observation: The previously confirmed recovery intention was submitted again.
decisions.rule: A digest-bound plan is single-use and revision-bound.

decisions.label: The previous writer acts after transfer
decisions.observation: Generation 0 attempted to mutate state after generation 1 took ownership.
decisions.rule: Only the active owner generation may write.

decisions.label: A write returns an uncertain response
decisions.observation: The resume apply response did not establish whether the event landed.
decisions.rule: Inspect durable state before retrying an external mutation.
decisions.result: Read-back confirmed the event; no duplicate mutation was issued.

decisions.label: A bounded UI change breaks preview portability
decisions.observation: Temporary preview roots could not resolve package-owned identity assets.
decisions.rule: Preview and production must resolve the same bundled application assets.
decisions.result: Asset resolution was separated from data roots; focused and full suites passed.

decisions.label: A validation spike contradicts the planned design
decisions.observation: A sampling spike found 90% of high cross-list co-occurrence was copy-lineage between related lists, not independent curation — the planned trust signal for cross-list search.
decisions.rule: A gating spike's finding changes downstream scope; it is not optional evidence to route around.
decisions.result: Cross-list search was redesigned before implementation: citation count became disclosed provenance, never a trust score; an independent-citation count reused the spike's own copy-lineage detector instead.

decisions.label: A subagent correctly refuses an unverifiable authorization
decisions.observation: A background subagent, isolated in its own worktree, declined to create issues, push, or merge — it had no way to independently verify the human authorization a parent session claimed on its behalf.
decisions.rule: Delegated authority must be exercised by the party that actually holds a verified authorization chain, not asserted into a context that cannot check it.
decisions.result: Execution was restructured: subagents draft and commit locally only; the orchestrating session — which holds the real, chat-verified authorization — performs every GitHub-facing action itself.

decisions.label: Autonomous execution still stops for a real human gate
decisions.observation: Two stories (community-intake writing to public issues from anonymous content; unattended auto-publish of catalogue data) were classified high-assurance by the Architect phase.
decisions.rule: High-assurance work requires actual human review before merge; self-review is forbidden outright at that profile, regardless of any standing autonomy grant.
decisions.result: Both pull requests opened and passed CI, then waited; the maintainer reviewed and merged each one directly.
